SELECT config.scene_name AS sceneName, config.scene_id AS sceneCode, config.algorithm_code AS algorithmCode, config.type_value AS alarmType, rel.alarm_type algorithmAlarmType, vac.model_config AS modelConfig FROM vm_algorithm_config vac INNER JOIN sys_scene_config config ON FIND_IN_SET(config.scene_id, vac.scene_code) > 0 AND config.delete_flag = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_scene_alarm_rel rel ON rel.scene_id = config.scene_id AND rel.delete_flag = 0 WHERE vac.task_id = #{taskId} AND vac.delete_flag = 0
AND rel.alarm_type IN
#{item}
( config.tenant_id = #{customer.tenantId} and config.industry_code = #{customer.industryCode} )
ORDER BY config.scene_name, rel.alarm_type
